from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from log import log

_session = requests.Session()
_session.trust_env = False


def getSiteUrl():
    return "http://www.shengxuxu.net"

def search(query):
    """
    书源搜索函数
    :param query: 搜索关键词
    :return [{"bookTitle":"书名", "bookUrl": "书籍链接", "bookAuthor": "作者"}, ...] 搜索结果列表
    """
    # POST请求的URL
    url = 'http://www.shengxuxu.net/search.html?searchtype=novelname&searchkey='
    # POST请求的数据
    data = {'searchkey': query.encode('utf-8'), "searchtype": 'novelname'}
    # 发送get请求
    response = _session.get(url, params=data, timeout=(5, 10))
    response.encoding = 'utf-8'
    log(response.text)
    # 创建BeautifulSoup对象
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    books = []
    for bookEl in soup.select(".librarylist > li"):
        books.append({
            "bookTitle": bookEl.select(".novelname")[0].text,
            "bookUrl": urljoin(url, bookEl.select(".novelname")[0].get("href")),
            "bookAuthor": bookEl.select(".info span")[1].text.replace("作者：",""),
        })

    return books


def getDetails(book_url):
    """
    获取章节列表
    :param book_url: 书籍链接
    :return
    {"url": "书籍链接", "title": "书名", "author": "作者", "intro": "简介", "cover": "封面链接",
     "chapterList": [{"title": "章节名", "URL": "章节链接"}, ...]
     }
    """
    book_url = book_url.replace("://m.", "://www.")
    # url book_url
    # 发送get请求
    response = _session.get(book_url, timeout=(5, 10))
    response.encoding = "utf-8"
    info = {}
    # 创建BeautifulSoup对象
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    info["url"] = book_url
    # 书名
    info["title"] = soup.select("meta[property='og:novel:book_name']")[0].get("content")
    # 作者
    info["author"] = soup.select("meta[property='og:novel:author']")[0].get("content")
    # 简介
    info["intro"] = soup.select("meta[property='og:description']")[0].get("content")
    # 封面
    info["cover"] = soup.select("meta[property='og:image']")[0].get("content")
    # 章节列表
    info["chapterList"] = []
    # document.querySelectorAll(".dirlist")[1].querySelectorAll("a")[1664]
    for el in soup.select(".dirlist")[1].select("a"):
        info["chapterList"].append({
            "title": el.text,
            "url": urljoin(book_url, el.get("href"))
        })

    return info


def getChapterContent(chapter_url):
    """
    获取章节内容
    :param chapter_url: 章节链接
    :return: 章节内容 html格式
    """
    # 发送get请求
    response = _session.get(chapter_url, timeout=(5, 10))
    response.encoding = "utf-8"
    # 创建BeautifulSoup对象
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    # 章节内容 html
    content = soup.select("#chaptercontent")[0].prettify()
    return content

headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/147.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/147.0.0.0",

        "title": soup.select_one("meta[property='og:novel:book_name']").get("content"),

        "intro": soup.select_one("meta[property='og:description']").get("content"),
        "cover": soup.select_one("meta[property='og:image']").get("content"),
        "chapterList": [],
    }

    # 目录只有一页，但 dl 内含“最新章节”和“正文卷”两段，只取“正文卷”之后避免重复
    in_body = False
    for el in soup.select(".listmain dl > *"):
        if el.name == "dt":
            in_body = "正文" in el.get_text()
            continue
        if not in_body:
            continue
        a = el.select_one("a")
        if not a or not a.get("href"):
            continue
        info["chapterList"].append({
            "title": a.get_text(strip=True),
            "url": urljoin(book_url, a.get("href")),
        })

    return info

    """
    获取章节内容
    :param chapter_url: 章节链接
    :return: 章节内容 html格式
    """
    response = _session.get(chapter_url, headers=headers, timeout=(5, 15))
    response.encoding = "utf-8"
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    content = soup.select_one("#content")
    if not content:
        return ""

    for tip in content.select("#content_tip"):
        tip.extract()
    html = content.prettify()
    return re.sub(r"最新网址[:：]\s*\S+", "", html)

    return "http://www.mayiwsk.info"

        "searchtype": "articlename",
        "searchkey": query
    }

    response.encoding = 'utf-8'
    html = response.text
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
    book_list_el = soup.select("#nr")
    results = []

    for book_el in book_list_el:
        result = {
            "bookTitle": book_el.select_one("td:nth-child(1) > a").text,
            "bookUrl": urljoin(url, book_el.select_one("td:nth-child(1) > a").get("href")),

        }

def getDetails(url):

    response = _session.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=(5, 15))
    response.encoding = 'utf-8'
    html = response.text
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
    book = {
        "url": url,
        "title": soup.select_one("[property='og:novel:book_name']").get("content"),

        "intro": soup.select_one("#intro").prettify(),

        "chapterList": []

    for chapter_el in reversed(soup.select("#list dl > *")):

            break
        chapter = {
            "title": chapter_el.select_one("a").text,

    content = soup.select_one("#content").prettify()

from urllib.parse import urljoin
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util import Retry
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from log import log

# 1. 初始化一个全局的 Session 对象，实现连接复用与 TCP 握手共享
session = requests.Session()

# 2. 配置底层自动重试机制
# 针对网络波动、超时以及临时服务器错误（如 500, 502, 503, 504）自动在底层重试
retries_strategy = Retry(
    total=3,  # 最大重试次数
    backoff_factor=1,  # 重试间隔等待时间系数 (e.g. 1s, 2s, 4s...)
    status_forcelist=[500, 502, 503, 504],  # 遇到这些状态码直接重试
    raise_on_status=False  # 即使失败也返回 response，不抛出异常以维持业务逻辑
)
adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries_strategy)
session.mount("http://", adapter)
session.mount("https://", adapter)

# 统一配置全局 headers
session.headers.update({
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/114.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8",
    "Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8",
})


# 3. 封装统一的内部请求方法（完全基于全局 Session，保障连接复用）
def _get(url, headers=None, timeout=(10, 30)):
    """
    使用全局 session 发起 GET 请求。
    因为挂载了 HTTPAdapter，该方法天然自带连接池复用与底层网络重试。
    """
    try:
        # 如果传入了临时 headers，会与 session.headers 进行合并
        return session.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        log.error(f"Request failed for {url}: {e}")
        raise

def getChapterContent(start_url):
    # 统一转换成移动端链接
    current_url = start_url.replace("https://www.", "http://m.")

    total_content = ""
    visited_urls = set()  # 避免死循环

    while current_url and current_url not in visited_urls:
        visited_urls.add(current_url)

        # 发送请求（通过 _get 内部走 Session 连接池，多页抓取时速度飞快）
        response = _get(current_url)
        response.encoding = "utf-8"
        html = response.text
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")

        # 1. 提取正文内容
        con = soup.select_one(".content")
        if con:
            total_content += con.prettify()
        else:
            con_fallback = soup.select_one("#content") or soup.select_one(".txt-content")
            if con_fallback:
                total_content += con_fallback.prettify()

        # 2. 寻找“下一页”链接
        next_url = None
        for a in soup.find_all("a"):
            text = a.get_text().strip()
            if "下一页" in text or "下页" in text:
                href = a.get("href")
                if href:
                    temp_url = urljoin(current_url, href)
                    if "?page=" in temp_url:
                        next_url = temp_url
                        break

        # 3. 判断是否继续抓取下一页
        if next_url and next_url != start_url:
            current_url = next_url
        else:
            break

    return total_content

"""
聚合搜索：用神马搜索（m.sm.cn）按书名检索，返回各小说站的书籍详情页。

APP 会按 bookUrl 的域名把结果归属到本地已安装的书源，
所以需要本地安装了对应站点的书源，结果才能真正打开。

说明：
- Bing 国内版对中文书名经常返回跑偏结果，且结果链接是 bing.com/ck/a 跳转，
  脚本无法直接拿到真实地址，因此改用神马搜索。
- 神马结果卡片的 data-url 指向书籍详情页（不是章节页），适合直接作为 bookUrl。
"""

import re

import requests

_UA = ("Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 13; Pixel 7) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
       "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36")
_HEADERS = {"User-Agent": _UA, "Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9"}

# 书名里常见的通用词，清理用户输入时去掉
_QUERY_NOISE = ("全文阅读", "在线阅读", "最新章节", "小说", "txt", "TXT")

_AUTHOR_NOISE = ("完本", "连载", "精校", "无弹窗", "免费", "下载", "章节目录")

def _normalize(text):
    """去掉空格与标点，便于书名匹配"""
    return re.sub(r"[\s《》<>“”\"'·,，。.!！?？:：;；_\-—|/\\]+", "", text or "").lower()


def _clean_query(query):
    text = (query or "").strip().strip("《》").strip()
    for word in _QUERY_NOISE:
        text = text.replace(word, " ")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


def _extract_author(title, book_title):
    """只认紧跟在书名后的括号作者，避免把“《书名(主角名)》”当成作者"""
    if not title:
        return ""
    # 标题通常以书名开头，去掉可能的前导书名号再匹配
    text = title.lstrip("《 <【[")
    pattern = re.compile(
        re.escape(book_title) + r"[^\s_《》\-|]{0,8}\s*[（(]\s*([^（()）]{1,16})\s*[)）]"
    )
    match = pattern.match(text)
    if not match:
        return ""
    author = match.group(1).strip()
    if any(word in author for word in _AUTHOR_NOISE):
        return ""
    return author


def _host_key(host):
    """m.hongxiu.com / www.hongxiu.com 视为同一站点"""
    parts = host.split(".")
    return ".".join(parts[-2:]) if len(parts) >= 2 else host


def _is_skipped(host):
    return any(host == item or host.endswith("." + item) for item in _SKIP_HOSTS)


def _fetch_page(keyword, page):
    url = f"https://m.sm.cn/s?q={quote(keyword)}"
    if page > 1:
        url += f"&page={page}"
    response = requests.get(url, headers=_HEADERS, timeout=(3, 4))
    response.encoding = "utf-8"
    return response.text


def _fetch_pages(keyword, pages=5, deadline=4.5):
    """并发抓取多页搜索结果，总耗时控制在 deadline 秒内"""
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, wait

    texts = []
    pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=pages)
    try:
        futures = [pool.submit(_fetch_page, keyword, p) for p in range(1, pages + 1)]
        done, _ = wait(futures, timeout=deadline)
        for page, future in enumerate(futures, start=1):
            if future not in done:
                future.cancel()
                continue
            try:
                texts.append(future.result())
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"聚合搜索第 {page} 页失败: {e}")
    finally:
        pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
    return texts


_SITE_MODE_PREFIXES = ("#书源", "#站点")


def search(query):
    """
    两种模式：
    - 默认：按书名搜索，返回可归属到本地书源的书籍；
    - 以 #书源 / #站点 开头：返回收录该书的所有站点（潜在书源）。
    :param query: 书名，或 “#书源 书名”
    :return: 书籍列表 [{bookTitle, bookUrl, bookAuthor}, ...]
    """
    raw = (query or "").strip()
    site_mode = False
    for prefix in _SITE_MODE_PREFIXES:
        if raw.startswith(prefix):
            site_mode = True
            raw = raw[len(prefix):].strip()
            break

    book_title = _clean_query(raw)
    if not book_title:
        return []

    texts = _fetch_pages(book_title + " 小说")
    if not texts:
        log(f"聚合搜索「{book_title}」: 无结果")
        return []

    query_key = _normalize(book_title)
    books = []
    index = {}
    seen_sites = set()

    def add(book_url, raw_title):
        book_url = (book_url or "").strip()
        if book_url.startswith("//"):
            book_url = "https:" + book_url
        if not book_url.startswith("http"):
            return
        # 跳过“第123章”这类章节页，只要书籍页
        if re.search(r"第\s*[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百千]+\s*[章节]", raw_title or ""):
            return
        # 跳过角色/人物介绍页
        if any(word in (raw_title or "") for word in ("角色介绍", "人物介绍", "角色档案")):
            return
        # 只保留以书名开头的结果，过滤“相关推荐”和简介片段
        if not _normalize(raw_title).startswith(query_key):
            return

        host = urlparse(book_url).netloc.lower()
        if not host or _is_skipped(host):
            return

        # 默认模式只返回本地已有书源支持的站点；发现模式返回全部
        if not site_mode and _host_key(host) not in _SUPPORTED_HOSTS:
            return

        # 模式二：每个站点只出一条“潜在书源”结果
        if site_mode:
            site_key = _host_key(host)
            if site_key in seen_sites:
                return
            seen_sites.add(site_key)
            books.append({
                "bookTitle": f"{site_key}（潜在书源）",
                "bookAuthor": "潜在书源站点",
                "bookUrl": book_url,
            })
            return

        # 同一本书的标题卡片、简介卡片可能指向同一地址，这里去重
        dedupe_key = re.sub(r"^https?://", "", book_url).rstrip("/")
        if dedupe_key in index:
            if not index[dedupe_key]["bookAuthor"]:
                index[dedupe_key]["bookAuthor"] = _extract_author(raw_title, book_title)
            return

        # 同一站点同一本书只保留一条（红袖等站点会产出多个 SEO 变体页）
        site_key = (_host_key(host), _normalize(book_title))
        if site_key in seen_sites:
            return
        seen_sites.add(site_key)

        book = {
            "bookTitle": book_title,
            "bookUrl": book_url,
            "bookAuthor": _extract_author(raw_title, book_title),
        }
        index[dedupe_key] = book
        books.append(book)

    for text in texts:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(text, "html.parser")

        # 模板一：结果卡片，data-url 通常就是书籍详情页
        for card in soup.select("div[data-url]"):
            title_el = card.select_one(".qk-title-text")
            if title_el:
                add(card.get("data-url"), title_el.get_text(" ", strip=True))

        # 模板二：富卡片/普通结果，直接解析链接（跳过已被卡片覆盖的链接）
        for a in soup.select("a[href]"):
            if a.find_parent(attrs={"data-url": True}):
                continue
            href = a.get("href") or ""
            if not href.startswith("http") or "sm.cn" in href:
                continue
            text = a.get_text(" ", strip=True)
            if not text:
                continue
            add(href, text)

    mode = "潜在书源站点" if site_mode else "书籍"
    log(f"聚合搜索「{book_title}」({mode}): {len(books)} 条")
    return books


def _unsupported(url):
    host = urlparse(url or "").netloc or url
    raise Exception(f"小说站点不支持：{host}，请先安装该站点的书源")


def getDetails(url):
    """聚合搜索只负责搜索，详情由 bookUrl 所属站点的书源提供"""
    _unsupported(url)


def getChapterContent(url):
    """聚合搜索只负责搜索，正文由 bookUrl 所属站点的书源提供"""
    _unsupported(url)


def getSiteUrl():
    # 聚合搜索没有固定站点，返回搜索页域名用于兜底
    return "https://m.sm.cn"
